actions: Resolved sanitized root control and cross_field role config from one SHA-only frozen tuple and rechecked the head before semantic work.
Read own LATEST/r76 state and reconciled an already-existing own r76 shell-to-KL1.25 certificate that superseded the stale dense-shell continuation text.

Derived and persisted an analytic terminal Gaussian t/F sentinel that uses existing sufficient statistics and gives a first-start KL>=1 miss upper bound below beta=0.09 without Monte Carlo radial shells.
Screened the sentinel PFA-share versus early-start coverage and established that fixed-time summable alpha still decays with start index.
Checked online-FWER fallback literature and rejected rejection-based alpha recycling as a pre-first-alarm solution.
Found exact sequential k-sample e-variable literature as a more appropriate late-start shared-capital route and checkpointed the unresolved full-Gaussian instantiation question.
key_result: A zero-extra-individualized-state terminal Gaussian sentinel analytically closes the unbounded KL>=1 power tail for the first materialized H=48/T0=700 start: miss <=0.07116965699646312 at beta=0.09 using eta=0.03 of the scale PFA budget, with only 0.030459207484708654 nats added to the retained SNML channel threshold. This is Gaussian-only and constants remain float64 rather than interval verified.
new_frontier: Determine whether Turner/Ly/Grünwald-style exact sequential k-sample e-variables can be instantiated for equality of two full N(mu,sigma^2) streams from count/sum/sum_sq and remain a test martingale when the finite baseline stream is frozen while only the post stream grows. If yes, compare its KL>=1 log-growth with the sentinel and SNML future-tail channel; if no, keep sentinel finite-prefix only and retain the existing future-tail e-process for indefinitely late starts.
termination_cause: End-of-invocation checkpoint after substantive progress; research frontier remains nonempty and this is not global completion.
